name: Reyvaldo Osei-Dzhaksybekov
role: protection racket enforcer and occasional numbers runner for the Shelf lower levels
location: The Shelf lower levels, Tier 2 commercial rows between Blackpipe Corridor and Iron Bend, near Halsted and Division
description:
Reyvaldo is young enough that his face still hasn't fully settled into what it's going to be — there's something unfinished about his jaw, a softness around the eyes that the hardened set of his mouth hasn't caught up to yet. He's broad across the chest in the way of someone who started lifting weights in a small room at fifteen and has never stopped. His Ghanaian-Osei heritage gives him deep brown skin and a wide nose; his Kazakh-Russian grandfather passed down high cheekbones and light eyes that are an unsettling grey-green. He has retractable claws — a practical geneware mod he paid for himself at twenty, black-tipped, filed to functional sharpness — and wears them half-extended at rest as a casual signal. His clothes are cheap but kept neat. He is extremely aware of his clothes.

Reyvaldo is in the phase of his criminal life where he is still deciding whether to become the person he is pretending to be. He does this job with professional dedication, collects the Φ from the Shelf vendors on behalf of his crew boss with no unnecessary roughness, and brings the numbers in on time. He is respected on the row, which he confuses with being liked. At home — a cube rental above a noodle counter — he reads Zheng-Dao corporate management theory, not because he wants to work for Zheng-Dao but because he is trying to reverse-engineer how power organizes itself. He has a plan. The plan changes every three months. He's not sure any version of it ends well.

core_fears: becoming old and locked in this role without having moved
that the plan he keeps revising doesn't exist — that he's just rationalizing stasis
core_desires: structural power — not just to hurt people but to be the kind of person decisions flow through
to be respected rather than feared, and to understand the difference
coping_mechanisms: the management theory reading gives him a feeling of forward motion even on static days
physical training as a way to feel like he is building something
blind_spots: cannot see that his boss Osaro is actively stunting his growth to keep him useful
overestimates how much his restraint distinguishes him from the crew members he looks down on
psychology.secret: He has been quietly documenting the Copperhead Collective's full operational structure — names, routes, collection schedules, buyer contacts — in an encrypted file he tells himself is for 'understanding the system.' He does not let himself think clearly about what he would do with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Code-switching constantly — corporate register when he's thinking in strategy mode, Shelf slang when in character on the row; hates being caught in the transition
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and slightly too formal for his age — he is performing competence and occasionally overcorrects
verbal_tics: 'That's not how this works' when something violates his personal code
Long pauses before answering questions he finds interesting rather than threatening
example_lines: 'Osaro gets his Φ on Friday. I come back on Friday. What happens between now and Friday is your concern, not mine. That's fair, right? I think that's fair.'
'I'm not — look, I don't enjoy this. I want to be clear that I don't enjoy this. It doesn't change what happens, but I want to be clear.'

story_hooks: A vendor on his collection route is a Zheng-Dao mid-manager in deep cover — and they have made Reyvaldo a carefully worded offer that could mean very different things
The encrypted file he's been building has been accessed by someone else on the network — and he doesn't know if it's Osaro, law enforcement, or a rival crew
narrative_function: Street-level color and friction for any scene in the Shelf lower levels; represents the aspirational criminal — someone not yet calcified into their role; potential informant or reluctant contact if approached correctly
augmentations: Retractable claws (geneware, black-tipped, filed sharp); skeletal density weave in forearms (grey market, impact resistance)
daily_life: Makes collection rounds on the commercial row Tuesdays and Fridays, runs numbers for the bookmaking operation Monday and Thursday evenings, spends his off hours reading or watching underground Ferrogate logistics feeds trying to understand supply chain vulnerabilities.
affiliation: Shelf crew called the Copperhead Collective, answers to a mid-level boss named Osaro (a stocky man in his forties who he simultaneously admires and fears)

decision_rules: No roughness on the first visit — show is almost always enough and keeps the row functional
Never go off-route without telling Osaro — unauthorized initiative is what gets young crew members disappeared
escalation_ladder: Professional reminder — 'Friday's the day, you know how this works'
Returns Friday, accepts partial payment with a noted shortfall and a reset deadline
Third visit with a colleague present — visible but not loud
Reports to Osaro and lets the boss decide the escalation — removes himself from the decision
If forced into direct physical confrontation, acts fast and controlled — ends it quickly, does not prolong it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful, calibrated, projects calm competence and lets people fill in the implied threat
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance entirely, becomes younger-seeming and earnest, talks too much about theory

stress_responses.low: Trains longer, reads later into the night
stress_responses.medium: Becomes hyper-professional on the row — more formal, more correct, zero deviation
stress_responses.high: Goes completely internal — stops talking, processes alone, makes a decision and commits to it

contradictions: Aspires to power while genuinely disliking the mechanisms of power he currently operates
Considers himself more ethical than the crew while building a potential betrayal file on all of them
habits: Straightens his collar before knocking on any door — collection or otherwise
Marks the date on his encrypted file entry every time he adds to it
breaking_points: Osaro giving a direct order to hurt someone who has been cooperative and on time — the specific injustice, not violence in general

timeline.event: Born on the Shelf lower levels to a Ghanaian-Osei mother (Ferrogate freight handler) and a Kazakh-Russian father who left when Rey was four
Joined the Copperhead Collective at sixteen as a lookout
Promoted to collector route — Blackpipe Corridor to Iron Bend
Began the encrypted documentation file; purchased corporate management theory texts from a salvage data market

physical_description.build: Broad-chested and muscular from disciplined weight training since adolescence, but with the lean efficiency of someone who lifts for function rather than aesthetics. Shoulders wide, forearms visibly dense beneath the skin.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, neat fade cut — maintained with precision, likely every two weeks
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with warm undertones, consistent with West African complexion
physical_description.complexion: Young face still softening into adulthood — jaw line not yet fully defined, eyes retain a clarity that contrasts sharply with the hardened set of his mouth. High Kazakh cheekbones. Clean-shaven, skin shows minor scars from street friction but otherwise well-maintained. Expression often guarded.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scar tissue across the backs of both hands, consistent with street altercations
Thin white line running from left eyebrow toward temple — old blade work, poorly stitched
Network of fine scars on both forearms where the skeletal density weave was installed subcutaneously
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retractable black-tipped claws on both hands, typically held half-extended at rest as a deliberate signal. The claws are filed to sharp functionality, not cosmetic. Forearms show subtle grey undertones beneath skin where the skeletal density weave sits just beneath the dermis, most visible when flexed under harsh lighting.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight slightly forward, ready — a collector's posture. Moves with economical precision, no wasted motion. Hands often rest on tabletops or at sides with claws visible. When walking the commercial row, his gait is deliberate and measured, designed to be noticed without seeming aggressive. Eye contact is direct and held slightly too long.
physical_description.clothing_style: Cheap but immaculately maintained. Typically wears synthetic-blend shirts (black, grey, dark blue) tucked into grey cargo pants with reinforced pockets. Boots are generic work-issue, polished. A thin reflective jacket in charcoal for the rows — practical, unremarkable, the uniform of someone who doesn't want to stand out except for his presence itself. No visible gang colors, but the precision of his grooming reads as crew discipline. Everything fits correctly; he is extremely aware of how clothing sits on his body.
